name: com.qorlie/qorlie
title: Qorlie
description: Make QR codes and editable links that never expire. Edit destinations and read scan analytics.

tools.name: create_static_qr
tools.description: Encode a URL or text into a QR code image and return PNG and SVG. Nothing is stored, no account is required, and the image cannot be edited later. Use this when the user only needs a one-off QR and will not change the destination after printing. Do not use this for a short link, scan analytics, or a code they may want to edit (use create_fixed_link or create_dynamic_qr after sign-in). `content` is the payload, max 2048 characters. `type` is the payload kind (for example url or text). `fgColor` and `bgColor` are hex colors. `frameText` is optional label text drawn on the frame.

type.description: Payload kind (for example url or text)

frameText.description: Optional label text drawn on the frame

tools.name: create_fixed_link
tools.description: Create a fixed (non-editable) short link and QR on the signed-in Qorlie account. The destination cannot be changed later; scans still count on the account. This uses one of the monthly free (or plan) link slots. Use this when the user wants a hosted short URL and QR they will not need to retarget. Use create_dynamic_qr instead if they may change the destination after printing, create_static_qr if they need no account and no short link, and deactivate_code if they later want the link to stop working. `url` is the destination URL. `name` is an optional label. `idempotencyKey` (max 64 characters) prevents duplicate creates on retry.

idempotencyKey.description: Prevents duplicate creates or updates on retry (max 64 characters)

tools.name: create_dynamic_qr
tools.description: Create an editable short link and QR on the signed-in account. The destination can be changed later with update_dynamic_qr without reprinting the code. This requires an Editable credit or a plan that includes editable codes. Use this when the user will print or share a code whose target may change (menus, campaigns, packaging). Use create_fixed_link for a non-editable hosted link, create_static_qr for a throwaway image with no account, and bulk_create_dynamic_qrs for many editable codes at once (Scan Pass or Business). `destinationUrl` is required. `title` is an optional label. `customSlug` is an optional custom short-link slug if the plan allows it. `idempotencyKey` prevents duplicate creates on retry.

customSlug.description: Optional custom short-link slug if the plan allows it

idempotencyKey.description: Prevents duplicate creates or updates on retry (max 64 characters)

tools.name: update_dynamic_qr
tools.description: Change the destination URL, title, or design of an existing editable code. The printed QR and short URL stay the same. This does not work on fixed (non-editable) links. Locked codes must be unlocked first: set `unlock` true and supply `reauthToken` when the app or prior error says reauth is required, or tell the user to unlock in the Qorlie app. Use this only to retarget or restyle an editable code you already have (get the `id` from list_dynamic_qrs). Use create_dynamic_qr to make a new editable code, and deactivate_code to stop the code from redirecting. `id` is required. `destinationUrl` and `title` are the fields to change. `destinationLocked` locks future edits. `designOptions` and `logoDataUrl` update artwork. `idempotencyKey` makes the same update safe to retry.

destinationLocked.description: Lock the destination against future edits

unlock.description: Set true with reauthToken when the code is destination-locked

reauthToken.description: Step-up reauth token from the app

logoDataUrl.description: Optional logo as a data URL

idempotencyKey.description: Prevents duplicate creates or updates on retry (max 64 characters)

tools.name: list_dynamic_qrs
tools.description: List every hosted code and short link on the signed-in account, both fixed and editable. Each item includes an `editable` flag, ids, short URLs, and destinations. Despite the historic name, this is not limited to dynamic/editable codes. Use this to find an `id` before update_dynamic_qr, get_qr_analytics, or deactivate_code, or to answer "what codes do I have?" Do not use this for scan totals (use get_account_analytics or get_qr_analytics) or to create codes. No input parameters.

tools.name: get_qr_analytics
tools.description: Return scan statistics for one hosted code on the signed-in account. The amount of detail (cities, devices, referrers, comparison) depends on the plan. Use this when the user asks about one specific code or short link (get `id` from list_dynamic_qrs). Use get_account_analytics for account-wide rollups across all codes, and get_plan to see which analytics the plan includes. `id` is required. `range` is a named window (for example 7d or 30d) unless `from` and `to` (ISO-8601 dates) are set. `granularity` controls bucket size. `compare` adds the previous period when true.

range.description: Named date window unless from and to are set

from.description: ISO-8601 start date for a custom range

to.description: ISO-8601 end date for a custom range

compare.description: Include the previous period when true

tools.name: get_account_analytics
tools.description: Return account-wide scan rollups across all of the signed-in user's codes, not a single code. Use this for totals, trends, and plan-level performance over a date range ("how did all my codes do last week?"). Use get_qr_analytics when the question is about one code, get_plan for limits and remaining credits, and list_dynamic_qrs to see the codes themselves. `range` is a named window unless `from` and `to` (ISO-8601 dates) are set. `granularity` controls bucket size. `compare` adds the previous period when true. Returned fields are plan-dependent.

range.description: Named date window unless from and to are set

from.description: ISO-8601 start date for a custom range

to.description: ISO-8601 end date for a custom range

compare.description: Include the previous period when true

tools.name: get_plan
tools.description: Show the signed-in account's plan name, links used this month, editable credits remaining, scans versus the included allowance, and which features are unlocked (including analytics depth, custom slugs, bulk create, and Bitly import). Use this before create_dynamic_qr, bulk_create_dynamic_qrs, or import_bitly_csv to check credits and plan gates, or when the user asks what plan they are on or what is left this month. Do not use this for scan totals (get_account_analytics) or to change the plan; `plansUrl` is the URL to send the user to if they want to upgrade. No input parameters.

tools.name: import_bitly_csv
tools.description: Preview (and, if confirmed, start) a Bitly CSV import onto the signed-in account. Requires Scan Pass or Business. By default this only previews the credit cost and row counts and does not create links; set `confirm` true only after the user accepts the preview. Actual creation may still need a follow-up in the Qorlie app or REST API if the preview says so. Use this when the user has a Bitly export to move. Use create_dynamic_qr or bulk_create_dynamic_qrs to make new Qorlie codes that are not a Bitly import. `csv` is the CSV text. `codeKind` chooses fixed vs editable imports when the plan allows it. `idempotencyKey` prevents duplicate imports on retry.

confirm.description: Set true only after the user accepts the preview cost

idempotencyKey.description: Prevents duplicate creates or updates on retry (max 64 characters)

tools.name: bulk_create_dynamic_qrs
tools.description: Create many editable short links and QR codes in one call. Requires Scan Pass or Business. Each item becomes an editable code the user can later change with update_dynamic_qr. Use this for a list of destinations (menus, seats, SKUs). Use create_dynamic_qr for a single editable code, create_fixed_link for non-editable hosted links, and import_bitly_csv for a Bitly CSV. `items` is the array of destinations (and optional titles/slugs). `idempotencyKey` prevents a duplicate batch on retry.

customSlug.description: Optional custom short-link slug if the plan allows it

idempotencyKey.description: Prevents duplicate creates or updates on retry (max 64 characters)

tools.name: deactivate_code
tools.description: Deactivate one of the user's fixed or editable codes so the short link and QR stop redirecting. The code and its scan history stay on the account and can be reactivated later in the app. This is not a permanent delete. Use this when the user wants a printed or shared code to stop working. Do not use this to change a destination (use update_dynamic_qr on an editable code) or to create a new code.

reactivate.description: Set true to turn the code back on if the plan allows it (default false)

unlock.description: Required true when reactivating a destination-locked editable code

reauthToken.description: Step-up reauth token from the app when unlock is required
